about.title: Our Mission
about.description: We are a political party committed to serving the people, strengthening communities, and creating meaningful opportunities for every citizen through responsible and inclusive governance.
about.driveText2: We believe lasting progress begins by listening to citizens, understanding the needs of every community, and turning those aspirations into responsible action. Our commitment is to work with integrity, accountability, and a clear focus on the public good.

highlights.title: People First
highlights.description: We put the needs, rights, and aspirations of citizens at the heart of every decision and public initiative.

highlights.title: Transparent Governance
highlights.description: We believe public institutions must be accountable, transparent, and responsive to the people they serve.

highlights.title: Inclusive Development
highlights.description: We work towards equal opportunities and sustainable development so that every community can participate in and benefit from progress.

vision.title: A Stronger Future for Everyone
vision.description: Our vision is to build a society where responsible leadership, inclusive development, and equal opportunity create a better future for every citizen.

mission.title: Serving the People, Strengthening Communities
mission.description: Our mission is to serve the people, empower communities, and create meaningful opportunities for every citizen through responsible and inclusive governance.

cta.title: Be Part of the Change
cta.description: Join us in building stronger communities and a future where every citizen has the opportunity to grow, contribute, and prosper.

news.title: Latest From Our Movement
news.description: Stay informed about our public initiatives, community programs, local engagements, and ongoing efforts to work for the people and create meaningful change.

publicServiceCenters.title: New Public Service Centers Launched Across Constituencies
publicServiceCenters.description: New public service centers are being established to help citizens access information, guidance, and support for essential services.
publicServiceCenters.content: The new public service centers are designed to make essential information and support more accessible to citizens. The initiative focuses on listening to public needs, improving access to services, and helping communities connect with the assistance they require.

communityMeetings.title: Listening to Citizens Through Local Community Meetings
communityMeetings.description: Local community meetings are bringing citizens and representatives together to understand concerns, priorities, and development needs.
communityMeetings.content: Community meetings provide an opportunity for residents to openly share their concerns and ideas. Our representatives are engaging directly with citizens to better understand local priorities and work towards responsible and practical solutions.

youthLeadership.title: Youth Leadership Program Encourages Community Participation
youthLeadership.description: A youth leadership initiative is encouraging young people to take an active role in community development and public participation.
youthLeadership.content: Young people have an important role to play in shaping the future of their communities. This initiative aims to encourage leadership, civic participation, and constructive engagement among the next generation.

greenDrive.title: Community Green Drive Promotes Sustainable Living
greenDrive.description: Citizens and volunteers came together for environmental awareness activities promoting cleaner and more sustainable communities.
greenDrive.content: The community green drive brought volunteers and residents together to raise awareness about environmental responsibility. The initiative encourages communities to adopt sustainable practices and take collective responsibility for protecting our surroundings.

volunteerNetwork.title: Volunteer Network Expands Across Regions
volunteerNetwork.description: Our volunteer network continues to grow, bringing more citizens together to support community-focused initiatives and public programs.
volunteerNetwork.content: The growing volunteer network reflects the strength of community participation. Volunteers are contributing their time and skills to support local initiatives and strengthen connections between citizens and community programs.

developmentPriorities.title: District-Level Discussion on Development Priorities
developmentPriorities.description: Citizens and community representatives came together to discuss local development priorities and important issues affecting their communities.
developmentPriorities.content: The district-level discussion created a platform for citizens to share their views on development priorities and local concerns. The feedback gathered from these discussions will help inform our understanding of community needs and priorities.

events.title: Join Us
events.description: Stay connected with our activities and take part in events that bring citizens together to discuss local priorities, community development, and our shared future.
events.notFound: The requested event could not be found.

cta.title: Bring Your Ideas to the Conversation
cta.description: Attend an upcoming event or contact us to learn how you can take part in your community and contribute to meaningful local development.

communityOutreach.title: Community Outreach Programme
communityOutreach.description: Meet our representatives and community members to discuss local priorities, public needs, and practical development initiatives.
communityOutreach.content: This community outreach programme provides citizens an opportunity to meet party representatives, share their concerns, and discuss priorities for local development. We believe meaningful public service begins with listening to the people and understanding the needs of every community.

youthLeadership.title: Youth Leadership Programme
youthLeadership.description: An initiative focused on youth leadership, skills development, education, and creating opportunities for the next generation.
youthLeadership.content: The Youth Leadership Programme encourages young people to participate in community development and public life. Through dialogue, learning, and leadership activities, the programme aims to help young citizens develop the skills and confidence to contribute positively to society.

publicMeeting.title: Public Meeting
publicMeeting.description: An open platform for citizens to interact with party representatives, raise local concerns, and share their views on development priorities.
publicMeeting.content: This public meeting provides an open forum for citizens to engage directly with party representatives. Community members can share their experiences, raise concerns, and discuss priorities that matter to their neighbourhoods and communities.

achievements.title: Making a Difference
achievements.description: Our commitment to public service is reflected in the work we undertake and the positive change we strive to create across communities.

communityInitiatives.label: Community Initiatives
communityInitiatives.description: Programs focused on improving the lives of people and strengthening local communities.

developmentProjects.label: Development Projects
developmentProjects.description: Initiatives supporting infrastructure, education, healthcare, livelihoods, and sustainable development.

peopleReached.label: People Reached
peopleReached.description: Citizens and communities engaged through public outreach, service initiatives, and development programs.

yearsOfService.label: Years of Service
yearsOfService.description: A continuing commitment to public service, responsible governance, and inclusive progress.

communityWellbeing.title: Community Wellbeing
communityWellbeing.description: Supporting practical initiatives that respond to the needs, concerns, and aspirations of local communities.

developmentOpportunity.title: Development & Opportunity
developmentOpportunity.description: Advancing initiatives that strengthen public services, infrastructure, education, employment, and livelihoods.

inclusiveProgress.title: Inclusive Progress
inclusiveProgress.description: Working toward development that creates meaningful opportunities and reaches citizens and communities across every stage of life.

achievements.closing: We measure our work by the difference it makes in people's lives and by the trust we earn through consistent, accountable public service.

leadership.title: Meet Our Leadership
leadership.description: Meet the leaders committed to serving the people with integrity, vision, accountability, and dedication.

nationalPresident.name: Leader Name
nationalPresident.shortBio: Providing leadership with a clear focus on public service, inclusive development, and the aspirations of the people.

vicePresident.name: Leader Name
vicePresident.shortBio: Working to strengthen communities and advance development opportunities through responsible and people-centred leadership.

generalSecretary.shortBio: Committed to transparent organisation, effective coordination, and accountable public service.

manifesto.title: A Practical Plan for Shared Progress
manifesto.description: Our commitments focus on the everyday priorities of citizens and on building stronger, more inclusive communities.

commitment.title: Priorities Shaped Around People
commitment.introduction: This manifesto sets out our priorities for focused action that can expand opportunity, strengthen public services, support local communities, and improve quality of life.

education.title: Education
education.description: Strengthen quality learning environments, improve access to education, and expand skills and opportunities that prepare every learner for the future.

healthcare.title: Healthcare
healthcare.description: Work toward accessible, affordable, and reliable healthcare services so that every family can access essential care with dignity.

employment.title: Employment
employment.description: Create conditions that encourage local enterprise, entrepreneurship, investment, fair opportunities, and meaningful employment for people across communities.

agriculture.title: Agriculture
agriculture.description: Support farmers through practical policies, sustainable agricultural practices, better access to markets, and stronger rural livelihoods.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Invest in dependable roads, public services, digital connectivity, and essential infrastructure that enables communities and local economies to grow.

womensWelfare.title: Women's Welfare
womensWelfare.description: Promote women's safety, equal opportunity, access to healthcare, education, and greater participation in economic and public life.

youthPrograms.title: Youth & Opportunities
youthPrograms.description: Expand pathways to education, skills, entrepreneurship, employment, and meaningful civic participation for the next generation.

participation.title: A Plan That Grows With Public Participation
participation.description: Your perspective matters. Read our commitments and share the priorities that matter most to your family and community.

hero.title: Your Voice Matters.
hero.description: Every meaningful change begins with a conversation. Share your ideas, concerns, suggestions, or simply connect with us.
